title: Marconi believed the Magenta craft non-human

tellings.quote: Some documents on later family confirmations indicate Maronei genuinely believed the craft could be non-human.

plain: In the 1930s an unusual craft was reportedly connected to Magenta, Italy, and Guglielmo Marconi, the Italian radio pioneer, is said to have truly believed it might not have been made by humans. Michels says this himself, pointing to "some documents" and later confirmations from Marconi's family that he does not name. If true, it would mean one of the great scientists of his time took the idea of a non-human craft seriously.
